# The application unit of this site, written by CelikPanel.
# Your own settings go in /etc/systemd/system/celikapp-4.service.d/*.conf (systemd drop-ins); CelikPanel never writes or removes them.
# An edit to this file is kept: CelikPanel then shows the difference and asks before writing it again.
# Kendi ayarlarınız /etc/systemd/system/celikapp-4.service.d/*.conf içine; CelikPanel onlara dokunmaz. Bu dosyadaki bir değişiklik korunur.
[Unit]
Description=CelikPanel app: set12-n.test
After=network.target

[Service]
User=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/celikpanel/subscriptions/2/sites/4/public_html
Environment=PORT=3001
Environment=NODE_ENV=production
Environment=PATH=/opt/celikpanel/runtimes/node/22.20.0/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/snap/bin
ExecStart=/bin/sh -lc '/opt/celikpanel/runtimes/node/22.20.0/bin/node -e "require('\''http'\'').createServer((q,s)=>s.end('\''set12-n1'\'')).listen(process.env.PORT)"'
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
